# Public Hugging Face federated data plane

Conductor track:
`conductor/tracks/public_hf_federated_data_plane_20260829/`

Make public Hugging Face datasets the durable data plane for every authorized
Australian MBS/PBS raw and derived object. Add medallion federation/distribution
v4, exact hosted publication, token-free digest verification, transient-cache
cleanup, source-specific dataset authorities, collection alignment, estate
registry reconciliation, and independent restore evidence.

The exact legacy composite
`edithatogo/global-medicines-atlas-international-open@654f71c...` is the first
visibility remediation because its 42-file manifest is byte-identical to an
already-public GMA composite. Licensed/unresolved private archives remain
private.

Requirements: M-108, M-112, S-016, C-011, C-012, C-013, C-015, W-003.
